title: cf-socket: verify connect completion on socket error events
body:
Closes #23445.

On macOS, a peer's graceful close can produce POLLHUP before curl checks connect completion, even with a response waiting to be read. Verify SO_ERROR on positive error events instead of treating them as an unconditional connection failure. Keep poll errors and failed connects as failures.

Added test 1991 with a local TCP peer that sends an HTTP response and closes before the multi loop resumes. On native macOS the test returns error 7 without the fix and succeeds with it.

Validation:
- macOS ARM64: 62 HTTP/FTP/libtest tests passed, 1 skipped.
- Fedora AArch64: the same 62 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- Closed-port connections still return CURLE_COULDNT_CONNECT on both systems.
- checksrc and git diff --check pass.

The test selection was 1991, 1–5, 100–145, and 500–510 (explicit test numbers). Test 506 was skipped because these builds use the threaded resolver.

AI assistance: implemented and tested with Codex.
